# National Youth Research Journal (NYRJ)

> NYRJ (ISSN 3143-3030) is an open-access, peer-reviewed, rolling-publication
> academic journal that publishes original student research from middle school
> through medical school, across every academic discipline. Founded by Madhav
> Arora; co-founded by Keyaan. Published in Atlanta, Georgia, USA.

All published articles are free to read, have permanent URLs of the form
https://nyrj.org/article/<title-slug>, and expose a directly downloadable PDF
at https://nyrj.org/api/public/article/<title-slug>/pdf

## Core pages
- [Home](https://nyrj.org/): journal overview and featured research
- [Library / Archive](https://nyrj.org/archive): every published manuscript
- [Submit a manuscript](https://nyrj.org/submit): submission requirements
- [Author guidelines](https://nyrj.org/guidelines): formatting and citation rules
- [Editing process](https://nyrj.org/editors): peer review and editorial workflow
- [Journal metrics](https://nyrj.org/metrics): turnaround times and publication stats
- [Advisory board](https://nyrj.org/advisors): academic and professional advisors
- [Team](https://nyrj.org/team): editors, reviewers, and staff
- [Chapters](https://nyrj.org/chapters): school chapters and chapter leads
- [Events](https://nyrj.org/events): conferences and symposiums
- [Guidance](https://nyrj.org/guidance): mentorship and video walkthroughs
- [Contact](https://nyrj.org/contact): NYRJINFO@Gmail.com

## Machine-readable
- [Sitemap](https://nyrj.org/sitemap.xml)

## Usage
Content may be quoted and cited with attribution to the National Youth
Research Journal (NYRJ), ISSN 3143-3030, including the article's permanent URL.
